title: Murrelektronik: Missing Authentication in aas-edge-client Reference Implementation allows Manipulation of AAS Data
excerpt: [VDE-2026-108] The aas-edge-client is a reference implementation of an Asset Administration Shell (AAS) edge application, published by Murrelektronik GmbH on GitHub for the LNI 4.0 testbed demonstrator. Its REST API is bound to all network interfaces on TCP port 18000, requires no authentication and accepts cross-origin requests from any origin. The reference implementation was never intended for productive use and is no longer maintained. Affected are all aas-edge-client versions.

summary.en: VDE-2026-108: Murrelektronik aas-edge-client REST API has no authentication and accepts cross-origin requests on all interfaces; all versions affected, no longer maintained.

summary.en: VDE-2025-081: Multiple WAGO PLCs and communication components are affected by CODESYS Control vulnerabilities leading to remote code execution; firmware below 4.10.0 is affected.
summary.nl: VDE-2025-081: Meerdere WAGO PLC's en communicatiecomponenten zijn getroffen door CODESYS Control-kwetsbaarheden die leiden tot remote code execution; firmware lager dan 4.10.0 is getroffen.

title: WAGO: Multiple Devices are affected by a Vulnerability in BACnet IP Stack
excerpt: [VDE-2025-102] Multiple WAGO devices are affected by a vulnerability in the dynamic creation of BACnet File Objects. The object name is used as a file path without sufficient validation and is not restricted to the intended directory, so relative paths can be used to reach files elsewhere in the file system.

summary.en: VDE-2025-102: Multiple WAGO devices have a BACnet IP stack flaw where unvalidated object names allow relative paths to reach files elsewhere in the file system.
summary.nl: VDE-2025-102: Meerdere WAGO-apparaten hebben een BACnet IP-stackfout waarbij niet-gevalideerde objectnamen relatieve paden toestaan naar bestanden elders in het bestandssysteem.

title: CODESYS Gateway Client - Uncontrolled Memory Allocation
excerpt: [Advisory2026-11_VDE-2026-094] The CODESYS Gateway Client (CmpGatewayClient) is used by various CODESYS products to establish PLC communication via the CODESYS Gateway. Due to missing limits on memory allocations derived from a size field in a gateway response, a malicious gateway can cause excessive memory consumption in the client, resulting in a denial-of-service condition. The vulnerability can be exploited when an affected product connects to an attacker-controlled gateway.

summary.en: CERT@VDE reports that the CODESYS Gateway Client can suffer denial of service via a malicious gateway response with an unlimited memory allocation size field.
summary.nl: CERT@VDE meldt dat de CODESYS Gateway Client denial of service kan ondervinden door een kwaadwillende gateway-respons met een onbeperkt geheugenallocatieveld.

title: CODESYS Control Runtime - Improper Synchronization in Monitoring
excerpt: [Advisory2026-12_VDE-2026-097] The monitoring functionality of affected CODESYS Control runtime systems processes read and write requests to PLC application data sent by the CODESYS Development System and other clients such as HMIs. Due to improper synchronization in the CmpMonitor2 component when processing concurrent requests from multiple clients, incorrect data may be read or written, potentially resulting in unexpected behavior of the affected product. PLCs based on the CODESYS Runtime Toolkit or CODESYS Safety SIL2 are affected if they allow simultaneous access by two or more clients…

summary.en: CERT@VDE reports improper synchronization in the CODESYS Control runtime monitoring component, which can cause incorrect data reads or writes when multiple clients send concurrent requests.
summary.nl: CERT@VDE meldt een onjuiste synchronisatie in de monitoringcomponent van de CODESYS Control runtime, waardoor onjuiste gegevens gelezen of geschreven kunnen worden bij gelijktijdige verzoeken.

excerpt: [VDE-2026-051] A vulnerability has been identified in ibaPDA, ibaDatCoordinator and ibaLogic. The affected applications do not properly restrict the .NET BinaryFormatter when deserializing client-server input. This could allow an attacker to cause a type confusion and execute arbitrary code within the affected applications. This is the same issue that exists for the .NET BinaryFormatter: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/code-quality/ca2300.

summary.en: CERT@VDE reports a deserialization vulnerability in iba ibaPDA and ibaDatCoordinator that allows arbitrary code execution via unrestricted BinaryFormatter use.
summary.nl: CERT@VDE meldt een deserialisatiekwetsbaarheid in iba ibaPDA en ibaDatCoordinator waarbij door onbeperkt gebruik van BinaryFormatter willekeurige code kan worden uitgevoerd.

excerpt: Industrial Edge Management contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform full account takeover by resetting user credentials without completing email verification. summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-503852 reports an authentication bypass in Industrial Edge Management allowing unauthenticated full account takeover via credential reset; updates are available.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-503852 meldt een authenticatiebypass in Industrial Edge Management waarmee ongeauthenticeerde aanvallers via wachtwoordreset volledige accountovername kunnen doen; updates zijn beschikbaar.

excerpt: WIBU Systems published information about a privilege escalation vulnerability under a certain circumstances and associated fix releases of CodeMeter Runtime, a product provided by WIBU Systems and used in several Siemens industrial products. summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-331739 covers a privilege escalation flaw in WIBU CodeMeter Runtime used in several Siemens industrial products; fixed versions are available.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-331739 behandelt een privilege escalation-fout in WIBU CodeMeter Runtime die in meerdere Siemens-industrieproducten wordt gebruikt; gepatchte versies zijn beschikbaar.

title: SSA-330084 V1.0: Client Code Execution Vulnerability in Desigo CC Product Family
excerpt: A Client Code Execution (CCE) vulnerability has been identified in Desigo CC, potentially allowing malicious actors to execute arbitrary code on client devices through specially crafted graphics documents. This vulnerability leverages user-defined graphics containing embedded scripts that are executed on client application instances. Successful exploitation could lead to compromise of the client operating system and potential lateral movement within the organization.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-330084 reports a client code execution flaw in Desigo CC, where crafted graphics documents can run code on clients and enable lateral movement.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-330084 meldt een client code execution-fout in Desigo CC, waarbij speciaal gemaakte graphics-documenten code op clients kunnen uitvoeren en laterale beweging mogelijk maken.

title: SSA-328642 V1.0: "Copy Fail" Vulnerability in Multiple Industrial Products
excerpt: Multiple Siemens products are vulnerable to the “Copy Fail” vulnerability. Siemens has released new versions for several affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions. Siemens is preparing further fix versions and recommends specific countermeasures for products where fixes are not, or not yet available.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-328642 reports multiple industrial products vulnerable to the Copy Fail vulnerability; fixes are released for several and further versions are in preparation.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-328642 meldt dat meerdere industriële producten kwetsbaar zijn voor de Copy Fail-kwetsbaarheid; voor enkele producten zijn fixes uitgebracht en verdere versies zijn in voorbereiding.

title: SSA-327438 V1.2 (Last Update: 2026-09-08): Multiple Vulnerabilities in SCALANCE LPE9403

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-327438 reports multiple vulnerabilities in SCALANCE LPE9403 affecting availability, integrity and confidentiality; a new version is available.

title: SSA-254516 V1.0: Arbitrary File Upload in OIS Web Module

Siemens has released patches and updates for Siveillance OIS to apply to the products that incorporate the OIS service, and recommends to update to the latest versions.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-254516 reports an arbitrary file upload in the OIS web module of Siveillance Control, enabling unauthorized root-level access; patches are available.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-254516 meldt een willekeurige bestandsupload in de OIS-webmodule van Siveillance Control waarmee onbevoegde root-toegang mogelijk is; patches zijn beschikbaar.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-229470 reports multiple vulnerabilities in SICAM 8 products before V26.20 that could lead to denial of service; new versions are available.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-216014 reports EFI variable vulnerabilities in SIMATIC IPCs, Tablet PCs and Field PGs allowing authenticated attackers to alter secure boot and password settings.

title: SSA-157465 V1.0: Reflected Cross-site scripting Vulnerability in Teamcenter

Successful exploitation may enable the attacker to read data or perform actions within the victim’s Teamcenter session. Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-157465 reports a reflected cross-site scripting flaw in the Teamcenter authentication redirect flow; new versions are available.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-157465 meldt een reflected cross-site scripting-fout in de authenticatie-redirect van Teamcenter; nieuwe versies zijn beschikbaar.

title: SSA-142885 V1.0: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Reyrolle 7SR5 Before V2.70
excerpt: Siemens Reyrolle 7SR5 Before V2.70 is affected by multiple vulnerabilities. Siemens has released a new version for Reyrolle 7SR5 and recommends to update to the latest version.

summary.en: Siemens advisory SSA-142885 reports multiple vulnerabilities in Reyrolle 7SR5 before V2.70 used in protection relays; a new version is available.
summary.nl: Siemens-advisory SSA-142885 meldt meerdere kwetsbaarheden in Reyrolle 7SR5 vóór V2.70, een beveiligingsrelais; een nieuwe versie is beschikbaar.

title: The hidden risks of shadow AI
excerpt: Understanding why staff use unapproved AI tools is key to managing the security challenges they can create.

summary.en: NCSC discusses why staff use unapproved AI tools and how to manage the resulting security challenges.
summary.nl: De NCSC bespreekt waarom medewerkers niet-goedgekeurde AI-tools gebruiken en hoe de beveiligingsrisico's te beheersen zijn.

title: SSA-887643 V1.0: Account Hijacking Vulnerability in Mendix SAML module
excerpt: Mendix SAML module contains a vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack an account in specific SSO configurations. Mendix has provided fix releases for the Mendix SAML module and recommends to update to the latest version.

summary.en: Siemens advises updating the Mendix SAML module to fix an account hijacking vulnerability in specific SSO configurations.
summary.nl: Siemens adviseert de Mendix SAML-module te updaten om een account-kaapvulnerability in specifieke SSO-configuraties te verhelpen.

title: $536 and 8 Hours: AI Learns to Attack a Different PLC
excerpt: Experts got Claude to port a PLC exploit, but it cost $536 and 8 hours, and a later AI-generated payload accidentally destroyed the hardware. Forescout researchers just answered a question that’s been hanging over industrial security for a while: can AI actually port a working exploit from one PLC to a different model with no […]

summary.en: Forescout researchers used AI to port a PLC exploit to a different model for $536 and 8 hours, though a later payload destroyed hardware.
summary.nl: Forescout-onderzoekers gebruikten AI om een PLC-exploit naar een ander model te porten voor 536 dollar en 8 uur, maar een latere payload vernielde hardware.

title: SAUTER: modulo 6 and EY-modulo 5 Vulnerability in Firmware update mechanism allowing remote code execution
excerpt: [VDE-2026-093] A vulnerability has been found in the firmware update process of SAUTER Building Controllers. The identified vulnerability could allow unauthorized code execution on affected controllers.

summary.en: CERT@VDE reports a firmware update vulnerability in SAUTER modulo 6 and EY-modulo 5 building controllers allowing unauthorized remote code execution.
summary.nl: CERT@VDE meldt een kwetsbaarheid in het firmware-updateproces van SAUTER modulo 6 en EY-modulo 5 gebouwregelaars, waarmee ongeautoriseerde code op afstand kan worden uitgevoerd.

title: ICSA-26-293-05: Hitachi Energy RTU500 Product
excerpt: Hitachi Energy is aware of vulnerabilities that affect RTU500 product versions listed in this document. These vulnerabilities if exploited can have impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability of the product. Please refer to the Recommended Immediate Actions for information about the mitigation/remediation. Sectors: Energy.

summary.en: CISA advisory ICSA-26-293-05 reports Hitachi Energy RTU500 vulnerabilities that could impact confidentiality, integrity and availability, with mitigations provided.
summary.nl: CISA-advies ICSA-26-293-05 meldt kwetsbaarheden in Hitachi Energy RTU500 die de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit en beschikbaarheid kunnen aantasten, met beschikbare mitigaties.

title: ICSA-26-293-04: Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 Product
excerpt: Hitachi Energy is aware of multiple vulnerabilities that affect MicroSCADA X SYS600 product versions listed in this document. These vulnerabilities can be exploited to carry out various attacks on the product. Please refer to the Recommended Immediate Actions for information about the mitigation/remediation. Sectors: Energy.

summary.en: CISA advisory ICSA-26-293-04 reports multiple Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 vulnerabilities that can be exploited for various attacks, with mitigations provided.
summary.nl: CISA-advies ICSA-26-293-04 meldt meerdere kwetsbaarheden in Hitachi Energy MicroSCADA X SYS600 die voor diverse aanvallen kunnen worden misbruikt, met beschikbare mitigaties.
